title: A Cooking Show
description: Four recordings from a TV cooking show: a chef making soup, a phone-in, a cake recipe and a closing talk.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Making vegetable soup
parts.intro: You will hear a chef, Chef Rosa, and her helper Ben on a cooking show.

script.speaker: Chef Rosa
script.text: Welcome to Cook with Rosa! Today, Ben and I are making a vegetable soup. It is easy, cheap and very healthy.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: I love soup, especially in winter. What do we need, Rosa?

script.speaker: Chef Rosa
script.text: We need two carrots, one onion and three potatoes. Ben, can you cut the onion first?

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Yes, but onions always make me cry! Is it OK if I wear my swimming glasses?

script.speaker: Chef Rosa
script.text: Ha ha, why not? Now we put a little oil in a big pot and cook the onion for five minutes.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Then I add the carrots and potatoes?

script.speaker: Chef Rosa
script.text: Exactly. After that, add water and a little salt. We don't need much, because too much salt is bad for you.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: How long do we cook it?

script.speaker: Chef Rosa
script.text: About twenty minutes. Some people add tomatoes, but I prefer to use green beans at the end. They look beautiful.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: It smells wonderful already. I can't wait to eat it!

parts.title: Part 2 · A phone call to the show
parts.intro: You will hear a viewer, Minh, phoning the show to ask the chef for help.

script.speaker: Chef Rosa
script.text: We have a caller on the line. Hello, you are on Cook with Rosa. What is your name?

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Hello, Rosa. My name is Minh, and I'm fourteen years old. I want to cook dinner for my parents on Saturday.

script.speaker: Chef Rosa
script.text: What a lovely idea! Do you like cooking?

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Yes, but I only know how to make eggs. My mum's birthday is on Saturday, and she loves pasta.

script.speaker: Chef Rosa
script.text: Then make a simple tomato pasta. It takes only fifteen minutes. Do you have a big pot?

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: We have one, but it's very old. Is that a problem?

script.speaker: Chef Rosa
script.text: Not at all. Just don't make the pasta too soft. Taste it after eight minutes.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: OK. And should I make a salad too?

script.speaker: Chef Rosa
script.text: Yes, a green salad is perfect. Oh, and one more thing. Light a candle on the table. It makes dinner feel special.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Thank you, Rosa. I will tell you how it goes!

parts.title: Part 3 · A cake recipe
parts.intro: You will hear Chef Rosa explaining how to bake a cake.

script.speaker: Chef Rosa
script.text: Now it's time for dessert. Today, I'm going to show you a chocolate banana cake.

script.speaker: Chef Rosa
script.text: First, heat the oven to one hundred and eighty degrees. Then mix two ripe bananas with a cup of sugar.

script.speaker: Chef Rosa
script.text: Next, add two eggs and some flour. If you don't have enough flour, don't worry. You can use a little less, and the cake will be softer.

script.speaker: Chef Rosa
script.text: Now the best part. Add the chocolate, but keep a few pieces to put on top. I always eat one piece. Okay, maybe two!

script.speaker: Chef Rosa
script.text: Bake the cake for forty minutes. To check it, put a knife in the middle. If the knife is clean, the cake is ready.

script.speaker: Chef Rosa
script.text: Finally, wait until the cake is cool before you cut it. I know it's difficult, but it tastes better!

parts.title: Part 4 · The end of the show
parts.intro: You will hear Chef Rosa at the end of the show.

script.speaker: Chef Rosa
script.text: Well, that's all we have time for today. Thank you for watching Cook with Rosa.

script.speaker: Chef Rosa
script.text: Next week, we have a special guest. A famous baker from Hue is coming to show us how to make Vietnamese pancakes.

script.speaker: Chef Rosa
script.text: Many of you asked for the recipe for today's soup. You can find it on our website, and you can also write to us. We will send it by post.

script.speaker: Chef Rosa
script.text: I'd also like to say a big thank you to Minh, who phoned today. He sent me a photo of his pasta dinner, and it looked great. His mum was very happy!

script.speaker: Chef Rosa
script.text: Remember, cooking is not about being perfect. It is about having fun and sharing food with people you love. Goodbye, and happy cooking!
